+30- Middleware in express js , what is middleware, example of middleware, types of middleware.
+
+
+Middleware kya hota hai?
+
+Middleware ek function hota hai jo request aur response ke beech execute hota hai.
+
+Flow:
+
+Client Request
+       |
+       ↓
+ Middleware
+       |
+       ↓
+ Route
+       |
+       ↓
+ Response
+Middleware function ke parameters:
+(req, res, next)
+req
+
+Request ki information:
+
+req.url
+req.method
+res
+
+Response bhejne ke liye:
+
+res.send()
+next()
+
+Next middleware ya route par jane ke liye.
+
+Example: Logger Middleware
+const logger = (req, res, next) => {
+
+    console.log(req.method);
+    console.log(req.url);
+
+    next();
+
+};
+
+
+app.use(logger);
+
+Agar browser me:
+
+GET /about
+
+open karo to console:
+
+GET
+/about
+
+
+

@@ -57,4 +57,66 @@
 /about
 
 
 
+////////////////////////////////
+Types of Middleware in Express JS
+1. Application Level Middleware
+
+Pure application par apply hota hai.
+
+Example:
+
+app.use((req,res,next)=>{
+    console.log("App Middleware");
+    next();
+});
+2. Router Level Middleware
+
+Specific router ke liye use hota hai.
+
+Example:
+
+router.use((req,res,next)=>{
+    console.log("Router Middleware");
+    next();
+});
+3. Built-in Middleware
+
+Express ke andar already available.
+
+Example:
+
+JSON data read karna:
+app.use(express.json());
+Static files:
+app.use(express.static("public"));
+4. Third Party Middleware
+
+External packages.
+
+Example:
+
+Install:
+
+npm install morgan
+
+Use:
+
+const morgan = require("morgan");
+
+app.use(morgan("dev"));
+5. Error Handling Middleware
+
+Error handle karta hai.
+
+Structure:
+
+(err, req, res, next)
+
+Example:
+
+app.use((err,req,res,next)=>{
+
+    res.status(500).send("Something went wrong");
+
+});
\ No newline at end of file
